    "Simple, intuitive interface reduced tool fatigue for managing multiple projects"

  "cons": [
    "Lacked advanced project management features like task dependencies or time tracking",
    "Customization options for dashboards and reporting were limited",
    "Finding specific older information could sometimes be challenging"
  ],
  "overall_experience": "The consultant likely found Basecamp to be a straightforward and effective tool for managing their e-learning projects and collaborating with clients. Its all-in-one approach helped maintain organization and streamline communication, reducing the need for multiple platforms. While its simplicity was a strength, they may have occasionally desired more advanced project management features or greater customization for complex workflows."
